lines.text: Did you know? Port is Latin for carry.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus carry?

words.ex: The city is improving its public transport.
The country imports most of its oil.
Vietnam exports rice and coffee to many countries.

publish.title: Port root: transport, import and export
publish.value: Port comes from Latin "portare" (to carry). Words: transport, import and export. transport = trans + port; import = im + port; export = ex + port.
